title: Lunar 2: Eternal Blue
native_title: ルナ２ ～エターナル・ブルー～
overview:
A girl murmurs, "My name is Lucia..." The boys' adventure began here!

- New encounters born of adventure... a moving, dramatic story!!
- Distinctive characters with varied movement and charming voices!!
- The appeal of the many event scenes: a sense of presence created by light, sound and motion!!

A thousand years after the age of the Dragonmaster, young explorer Hiro and his companion Ruby investigate a strange light at the Blue Spire, a tower in the world of Lunar. There they meet Lucia, a girl from the Blue Star who must reach the goddess Althena to prevent a disaster, and Hiro is swept up in her mission.

In this role-playing game, explore towns and dungeons, talk to the people you meet and follow a story told through animated scenes. In battle, move your party into range, attack and cast magic, and grow stronger with every victory.

- 1 player
- 2 discs

少女が呟く「わたしの名はルーシア…」
少年たちの冒険はここから始まった！

◆冒険が生む新たな出会い…感動のドラマチックストーリー！！
◆多彩な動きと魅力的なVOICEによる個性豊かなキャラクターたち！！
◆数多くのイベントシーンの魅力は光と音と動きの演出が生む臨場感！！
